item.title: Special Live Event: Allies and Adversaries & Depths of the Damned out now!
item.description:
Free Update out now!

The Depths of the Damned Free Update is now live! Try out the new weapons, play the new Terror of the Deep story mini-campaign, and delve into the depths of the new Spillway mission to battle the brand new boss fight: The Prophet of Decay!

 Check out the full announcement here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1361210/view/712287592723252699

Special Live Event: Allies and Adversaries

In an effort to boost relations with our allies, Interrogator Rannick has ordered members of the warband to assist various influential figures. 

Starting now until October 13th, play all of the Terror in the Depths campaign missions to progress in the ‘Allies and Adversaries’ event, obtaining Plasteel, Ordo Dockets, Diamantine, and this brand new Insignia as a reward!

New Regimental Rotation: Death Korps of Krieg 158th - 16:00 CEST

The Depths of the Damned Update will also bring a new rotation of Premium Cosmetics in the Commodore’s Vestures, including a new Regimental Rotation: Krieg 158th!

This rotation will go live later today, at 16:00 CEST!

That’s all for today! Venture into the Depths, and hunt the Prophet of Decay!

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar. 

– The Darktide Team

item.title: Patch 1.13.0 patch notes
item.description:
Warband!

Patch 1.13.0 is now being rolled out on all platforms! The ‘Depths of the Damned’ Free Update is releasing later today, at 14:00 CEST. In the meantime, you can check out the patch notes below to read all about the changes, as well as the content coming with the Free Update, such as the new mission, new weapons, and more!

14:00 CEST - Free Update, Depths of the Damned

New Story Mini-Campaign: Terrors of the Deep

This update comes with a brand new Story Mini-Campaign, a series of three missions with a connected narrative, similar to the ‘Battle for Tertium’ campaign or the ‘No Man’s Land’ mini-campaign. The first two missions will be in ‘Consignment Yard’ and ‘Enclavum Baross’, as the Strike Team sets out to aid noble allies of the Inquisition.

The third and final mission will be in ‘Spillway’, a brand new mission releasing with this update. The Strike Team must venture into the depths of the Torrent to aid the Ragged King and investigate the hidden horrors…

New Mission: Spillway

Descend to the depths of the Torrent in the new mission: Spillway. The Ragged King is losing Water Cartel members to something lurking in the warren of sewers beneath the ancient dam. Get down there, clear out the Traitorous Sixth and deal with whatever has made its lair down there.

Read all about it in our previous Feature Highlight, here!

New Boss: The Prophet of Decay

The new Spillway mission has a surprise at the end… get ready to face a brand new boss fight, unique to this level! Who is the source of the corruption festering in the Depths? How will you defeat him?

A terrifyingly powerful Psyker of Nurgle… Are you ready to face the Prophet of Decay?

New Weapons

Read all about the new weapon families and marks coming out with Depths of the Damned here!

Krourk Mk IIa Cruncher

“We're gonna need a bigger bonk, sah”

Overview

An industrial sledgehammer of immense weight and size, this weapon can only be wielded by equally enormous Ogryns.

While each swing is ponderous, it also carries huge stagger, above average cleave potential, and amazing reach.

The moveset of the weapon is straightforward, allowing to chain attacks in a pleasing, destructive rhythm.

Additionally, if the windup of an Heavy or Special attack is maintained for a longer period of time, the weapon will accumulate up to 4 stacks of +10% Melee Strength for the following attack.

This weapon is available to the Ogryn class.

Weapon Special

Pressing the Special input initiates a unique windup animation, raising the Cruncher above the Ogryn’s head and giving access to devastating Strikedown attacks.

If the Special input is released immediately, the weapon will perform a Light 1 or Light 4 attack (depending on the combo chain); if the input is held, the weapon will release an Heavy Special Strikedown attack.

Attacks

  • Light 1: Moderately fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Impact and Damage.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

  • Light 2: Moderately fast, diagonal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.

  • Light 3: Moderately fast, diagonal uppercut Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.

    • Chains into Light 4 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

    • Also accessed while in a Slide stance.

  • Light 4: Moderately fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Impact and Damage.

    • Chains into Light 1 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.

  • Heavy 1: Slow, horizontal Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

  • Heavy 2: Slow, horizontal Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.

  • Push-attack: Fast, horizontal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

  • Special 1: Very slow, vertical Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

  • Special 2: Very slow, vertical Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.

    • Also accessed after a Push.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.

Suggested Horde combos

  • H1 > H2 > H1 > …

  • H1 > L2 > L3 > H2 > …

  • Push-attack > L2/H2 > …

  • (Slide) > L3 > H2 > …

Suggested Single Target combos

  • Sp1 > Sp2 > Sp1 > …

  • L1 > (Special) L4 > L1 > …

  • (Any) > Sp1/Sp2 > …

  • (Any) > (Special) L1/L4 > …

Blessings

  1. Hammerblow

    1. +19-25% Impact for 1.5s on Hit. Stacks 5 times.

  2. Execution

    1. +5-20% Damage Bonus vs Staggered enemies.

  3. All or Nothing: Up to +15-30% Strength, as Stamina depletes. (Note that this version of the Blessing scales for every 12.5% depleted Stamina, instead of 20%.)

  4. Limbsplitter: +17.5-25% Strength on your First Attack every 2 seconds.

  5. Slow and Steady: Recover 15-24% toughness when hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, based on charge time.

  6. Shock & Awe: - 30-60% Enemy Hit Mass for 3s on Kill.

  7. Unstoppable Force: Fully Charged Heavy Attacks ignore Enemy Hit Mass and have +2.5-10% Damage.

  8. Take a Swing: +45-60% Weak Spot Damage for 6 seconds on Pushing Enemies.

Krourk Mk VII Crusher

Overview

This mark of the Crusher family sports the signature high-finesse Push-attack uppercut, and has easy access to looping Strikedown and Relentless attack chains.

The Special activation is more powerful, but also limited by a cooldown.

This weapon is available to the Zealot and Arbites classes, and unlocked from the Crusher weapon family Mastery track.

Weapon Special

The Special action empowers the weapon for a short amount of time, causing the next hit to trigger a shockwave around the point of impact.

This explosion has more damage, impact and range compared to the one from the Indignatus mark, but also enters a cooldown of several seconds before the Special activation can be performed again.

Attacks

  • Light 1: Fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Impact and Damage.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.

  • Light 2: Fast, horizontal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1.

  • Light 3: Fast, diagonal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave, and increased Damage.

    • Chains into Light 4 and Heavy 2.

    • Also accessed after a Special activation.

  • Light 4: Fast, diagonal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave, and increased Damage.

    • Chains into Light 1 and Heavy 1.

  • Heavy 1: Slow, horizontal Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.

  • Heavy 2: Slow, diagonal Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 3.

  • Heavy 3: Slow, vertical Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.

    • Also accessed after a Special activation.

  • Push-attack: Fast, diagonal uppercut Vanguard attack with good Damage and Cleave, and increased Finesse.

    • Chains into Light 4 and Heavy 2.

    • Also accessed while in a Slide stance.

Suggested Horde combos

  • H1 > L2 > H1 > …

  • H1 > L2 > L3 > L4 > H1 > …

  • Push-attack / Slide Light attack > L4 > …

  • Special activate > L3 > …

Suggested Single Target combos

  • L1 > H2 > H3 > H2 > …

  • Push-attack / Slide Light attack > H2 > …

  • Special activate > H3 > …

Gromm Mk I Battle Maul and Mk V Slab Shield

Overview

This mark of the Battle Maul & Slab Shield family shares the Heavy attacks and Special action, but possesses a unique, Strikedown-oriented Light attacks chain.

This weapon is available to the Ogryn class, and unlocked from the Battle Maul and Slab Shield weapon family Mastery track.

Weapon Special

The Special action plants the Slab Shield in a defensive position, allowing it to block attacks indefinitely while remaining still.

Attacks

  • Light 1: Moderately fast, horizontal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.

  • Light 2: Moderately fast, uppercut Strikedown attack with good Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1.

  • Light 3: Moderately fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 4 and Heavy 2.

  • Light 4: Moderately fast, diagonal Strikedown attack with good Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 1 and Heavy 1.

  • Heavy 1: Slow, shield Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.

  • Heavy 2: Slow, shield Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.

    • Chains into Light 1 and Heavy 1.

  • Push-attack: Fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2.

Suggested Horde combos

  • L1/H1 > H2 > L1/H1 > …

Suggested Single Target combos

  • H1 > L2 > L3 > L4 > H1 > …

  • Push-attack > L2 > …

  • H1 > (Block Cancel) > H1 > …

Huntsman’s Shotgun Accatran Mk III

Overview

A pump action shotgun, Commonly used on Atoma. Fires devastating cones of pellets. Very effective close to mid range.

This weapon is available to the Veteran, Zealot, Psyker and Hive Scum classes.

Weapon Special

Flashlight. Be there light, followed by pellets.

Blessings

  1. Terrifying Barrage: Suppress Enemies within 5-8m Radius on Close Range Kill.

  2. Full Bore: +14-20% Strength for 5s when every bullet in a shot hits the same enemy.

  3. Born In Blood: +4.5-6% Toughness on Close Range Kill.

  4. Speedload: +7-10% Reload Speed for 3 seconds after Close Kill. Stacks 5 times.

  5. Flechette: 3-6 Bleed Stacks on Critical Hit.

  6. Gloryhunter: +10-16% Toughness on Elite Kill.

  7. No Respite: Up to +14-20% Damage on Hit (Staggered Enemy), scaling with Stagger.

  8. Scattershot: +6-12% Critical Chance for each Enemy Hit by your previous attack. Stacks 5 times.

  9. Deathspitter: +5-6.5% Strength for 3.5s on Close Range Kill.

Double-Barrelled Shotgun Krourk Mk IV

“Unsawed off”

Overview

Standard issue double barreled shotgun. Opposite to the sawed off, this mark shoots both barrels from the hip, and single shot when aiming down sights.

This weapon is available to the Veteran, Zealot, Psyker, Arbites and Hive Scum classes, and unlocked from the Double-Barrelled Shotgun weapon family Mastery track.

Weapon Special

Bash to the face if enemies are close and both barrels are empty.

Thugshot Lorenz Mk VII

Overview

A slug shot variant of the Kickback. 

Being an Ogryn weapon it is like wielding a human cannon, as the slug is giant sized. 

This weapon is available to the Ogryn class.

Weapon Special

Bash the heretic! Counts as a Heavy attack.

Blessings

  1. Run ‘n Gun: You can Hipfire with this weapon while Sprinting. +6-15% Close Damage while Sprinting. Also reduces weapon spread at all times by 30%.

  2. Surgical: +10% Critical Chance for every 0.35-0.2 seconds while aiming. Stacks 10 times. Discharges all stacks upon firing.

  3. Pierce: Special Attacks gain +10-25% Stagger and ignore Hit Mass Bonus from Armour.

  4. Blaze Away: +6-9% Strength for every shot fired during continuous fire. Stacks 5 times.

  5. Punishing Fire: +6-15% Strength on your ranged attack for 3 seconds after cleaving through several enemies with your weapon's special attack.

  6. Terrifying Barrage: Suppress Enemies within 5-8m Radius on Close Range Kill.

  7. Inspiring Barrage: +1-4% Toughness for every shot fired during continuous fire. Stacks 5 times.

  8. Expansive: +30-42% Melee Strength for 3.5s on Hitting 3+ Enemies with a Ranged Attack.

Patch 1.13.0 patch notes

Features & Tweaks

Performance

  • AMD FSR MLD update

    • Updated to AMD FSR SDK 2.3.0, which includes several ML-based rendering improvements.

    • Added a new Reflection Denoiser option for ray-traced reflections on certain GPUs: AMD FSR Ray Regeneration, an alternative to the existing NRD denoiser. It can be selected in the Video settings menu when Ray Traced Reflections are enabled, and is designed to reduce noise in reflections.

  • Updated Nvidia Streamline to version 2.12.0

    • This version gives general stability improvements & enhanced resource and frame tracking.

General Changes

  • Added End Of Round statistics.

    • Pressing the corresponding button during the end of a mission (default Tab / L3) will show a breakdown of various stats from your actions during the last mission, as well the entire team’s.

  • Expeditions:

    • Higher difficulties will now spawn more Tech-Remnants (the higher the difficulty, the more Tech-Remnants will spawn).

    • Increased experience, mastery, and ordo docket rewards for completing Expeditions (scaled with the number of Tech-Remnants extracted).

    • Tweaked Pacing Manager settings for Expeditions.

    • The amount of crafting materials spawned now varies between zones (later zones will have more, with a sharp increase on the last one).

    • Expedition Extraction rewards are now increased based on the number of players that successfully extract. 

      • 2 players = +10%, 3 players = +15%, 4 players = +20%.

    • Players should no longer inherit damage from Bots when hotjoining into an Expeditions mission.

    • Sand Dust particles are toned down in Expeditions missions during the ‘Dawn’ condition.

    • When hotjoining into an Expeditions mission, you will now inherit Salvage that the team gathered during the current location.

    • Players that reconnect to a live Expeditions mission are given back any Salvage they earned before leaving.

    • Expeditions luggable loot (such as Data Reliquaries) now becomes tracked on the Auspex when a player picks it up.

    • Adjusted framing of portrait Frames to show more of the face and headgear and less of the neck.

  • Added more detailed Operator Stats in the Loadout and Talents screen.

    • Pressing the corresponding button (Default: W / LT / L2) while in the Loadout or Talents screen shows detailed current stats for your Operator, taking into account currently equipped gear, talents and passives.

  • Adjusted framing of Ogryn portrait Frames to be slightly less zoomed in.

  • The Servo Skull companion has been added to the Skitarius class selection screen.

  • Improved the visuals of the voice modulation visualization in the Skitarii Voxcaster customization step.

  • Locked campaign missions will now only display the last unlocking step needed, unless the steps can be completed independently.

  • If you are hit during the throwing animation of an objective item, you now keep throwing the item instead of dropping it.

  • Updated the Hive Scum ‘Battering Momentum’ talent description to better reflect the Cleave increase being applied to both melee and ranged attacks.

  • Skitarii’s ‘Advanced Combat Doctrines’ now always aims towards the head of a Chaos Spawn.

  • Added additional tagging validation to prevent Tagging on enemies not near the point of the player's aim.

  • Slightly reduced memory use in various menus.

  • Added various improvements on loadout presets to improve validation of missing items or talents, as well as how they store the loadout information.

  • Added the ability to rate a mission during the End of Round screen. Thumbs up if you enjoyed the match!

Quality of Life Changes

  • Controllers: Added Gyro Controls

    • PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 controllers can now manipulate the camera by tilting the controller when the setting is turned on ( Motion Sensor Function, in the Controller settings menu). You can also fine tune various settings, choose which contexts the controls kick in, and quick flick options.

  • Social Menu Improvements

    • When looking at your friends in the Social menu, players on the same platform that are offline or haven’t selected a character yet will now show their profile picture.

    • Steam: You can now open other players' Steam profiles directly from the Social menu.

  • Allowed deselecting any talent in the Talent Tree. Any orphaned talent will flash red.

  • The Starting Node of the Talent Trees can now be hovered to view your class Iconic Passives.

  • Added the Beast of Nurgle, Plague Ogryn, Chaos Spawn, Ogryn Pack Master, and Armoured Pox Hound enemies to the Meat Grinder.

  • Improved input handling to be more reliable when switching between weapons.

  • Reduced the chance of randomizing the same preset or name twice in a row in the character creation screen.

  • Claiming a Penance no longer blocks user input until backend communication is done.

Balance Changes

As part of the Depths of the Damned Free Update, we have a balance update. Our focus has been on improving the base classes talent trees, overall class balance, weapon balance, and addressing Golden Toughness and its impact on both player builds and our overall design space for the future. Since we are making changes that will affect all players, regardless of class and loadout, it’s important for us to go through our thought process.

The original four Classes are receiving several changes to their talent trees, with a particular focus on reducing the number of stat nodes required to complete your build, and improving the paths through the trees with the intent of providing more interesting choices and improving buildcraft. We are also looking to reinforce what makes the Veteran and Zealot stand out from the other Classes, by taking a closer look at their themes and mechanics. The Skitarius has now had some time to settle, so we are also going over its talents and abilities and making some targeted adjustments. NOTE: Since the changes affect the layout of the trees, your loadouts may need slight rearrangements to amend broken connections or reapplying of points to make up for removed talents. Rest assured that these are only partial resets.

Several Melee Weapons are also receiving changes, with the Thunder Hammer in particular getting some extra attention. 

Finally, we are taking a closer look at Golden Toughness. In May, we outlined our intention to improve combat balance by addressing some of the outliers in player power, and took the first steps by adjusting Carapace Armoured enemies and the players tools to deal with them. You can read that balance blog here. 

Our commitment is still to preserve the intensity of the combat, while making it more stable, more readable, and more supportive of different builds and loadouts. Adjusting Golden Toughness is another step towards that long-term goal.

Golden Toughness

Golden Toughness is one of the more disruptive mechanics in Darktide. By changing the way damage and toughness interact, it can obscure some of the core rules of combat.

Many players are naturally guided towards abilities that provide Golden Toughness, and these abilities can be highly effective even before a player has developed a strong understanding of the mechanics they are intended to learn, e.g. positioning, and how to engage each type of enemy. This can allow difficult situations to be bypassed or diffused without engaging with the underlying threats, making it harder for players to build that understanding through the intended learning curve.

When Golden Toughness was first introduced to Abilities, Darktide was in a very different state. Since then, the overall difficulty and complexity of the game has increased, and the value of Golden Toughness has increased alongside it. As its value has grown, it has also become increasingly difficult to balance abilities against one another without making Golden Toughness a prerequisite for competing with its level of defensive power.

We want Toughness to have consistent and understandable rules regardless of how it is obtained. To that end, we are removing the Spillover Immunity effect from Golden Toughness. It will now follow the same damage calculation rules as regular Toughness.

This means that Golden Toughness will continue to provide additional protection, but it will no longer allow a single point of Toughness to fully absorb the damage of an otherwise lethal attack. The result should be a more consistent combat system, and greater room for us to balance defensive abilities against one another.

  • Spillover immunity - Removed

  • Voice of Command - Duty and Honour

    • Toughness Bonus 50 -> 75

  • Chorus of Spiritual Fortitude

    • See Zealot Changes

To accompany these changes we’re also making adjustments to the enemies where Golden Toughness gave players the largest benefit.

  • Poxbursters

    • Explosion Damage now falls off based on distance

      • 20% of full damage at the edge (6m)

      • 100% of full damage within 3m

  • Snipers

    • Damage Spillover reduced by 50%.

      • Dev Note: this is the damage that is applied to Health if a Sniper’s shot completely removes Toughness on the target.

  • Ogryn Crushers

    • Lowered chance to target players that are already overwhelmed

  • Scab Mauler

    • Slightly reduced the rate at which they utilize their overhead attack

We know that these will cause changes in the meta and balance of higher difficulty play, and will keep a close eye on how the affected classes perform.

Ogryn

We are making changes to the Ogryns Talent Tree with the intent of making it easier and more intuitive to create builds. We have made changes to the top part of the tree to make the choices feel more in tune with the build you’re going for. We have also made the higher pick rate talents a bit more available, so that you spend less points to get the nodes you need, and more on the nodes you want.

  • Stat Nodes Removed:
    Dev Note: Most stat nodes have been removed. We’ve added back some Toughness to the Ogryn’s Base Toughness. We have increased the value of Keep Shooting and Dominate to make up for the lost Rending and Reload Speed.

    • 25 Toughness

    • 25 Toughness

    • 15 Toughness

    • 5% Toughness Damage Reduction

    • 5% Rending

    • 5% Reload Speed

    • 10% Melee Damage

    • 10% Ranged Damage

  • Base Toughness increased from 75 -> 125

  • Towering Presence
    Dev Note: Towering Presence, while thematic, has never been that interesting of a pick. We’re reducing its effectiveness slightly, but are making it an Iconic passive.

    • Now Baseline

    • Coherency Radius 75% -> 50%

Dev Note: To make up for the removed stat nodes, we are redistributing some of the values over other nodes.

  • Dominate

    • Rending 10% -> 15%

  • Keep Shooting

    • Reload Speed bonus increased from 15% -> 20%.

  • Soften Them Up

    • Enemy Damage Taken 10% -> 15%

Dev Note: Along with these layout changes, we are taking a pass on Ability Cooldown modifiers, to better balance the abilities according to the power they provide.

  • Go Again!

    • 2% Cooldown -> 1.5%

  • Maximum Firepower

    • Duration 4s -> 2.5s

  • Bruiser

    • Cooldown Regen 100% -> 50%

    • Duration 3s -> 4s

  • Indomitable (Ability)
    Dev Note: Indomitable has continued to struggle in terms of impact compared to its competitor abilities. Easing up on the restrictions of its modifiers will hopefully allow for a few more build angles. We are also lowering its cooldown to make up for a loss of cooldown reduction on Bruiser.

    • Cooldown 30s ->  25s

    • Subnodes now moved to no longer be exclusive, and all branch directly from the Ability

Dev Note: Turns out the Ogryn’s pockets were deeper than he first thought. More rations for both him and his guns.

  • Found Some More - New

    • Replenish 1% Ammo every 15s.

Zealot

We are making changes to the Zealot’s Talent Tree with the intent of solidifying its strengths and expanding on one of the features that is unique to it. We have also made some smaller pathing changes to the layout in an effort to give you a couple extra points to spend on the new additions.

  • Stat Nodes Removed
    Dev Note: We are pruning a few nodes to make space for larger changes. The toughness we are adding to your base toughness pool. The Movement Speed you will instead find in ‘Faithful Frenzy’.

    • 5% Movement Speed

    • +25 Toughness

  • Base Toughness

    • 100 -> 125

  • Faithful Frenzy

    • Now also grants 5% Movement Speed

  • Blood Redemption
    Dev Note: We consider Melee Combat to be the bread and butter of the Zealot, and feel like Blood Redemption would be a well placed Iconic passive for the Zealot.

    • Now baseline

    • Toughness Bonus from Kills 100% -> 75%

  • Until Death reimagined as a ‘Core Keystone’
    Dev Note: We want to double down on the faster, fighting on the edge, type of gameplay for the Zealot. To do this we are expanding on the thematic ‘Until Death’ talent.

    • During the effect you are Unkillable. (Same type of effect as previously)

    • Duration 6s -> 8s

  • Until Death Subnodes:

    • Holy Revenant

      • Triggering Until Death knocks back nearby enemies. While Unkillable, dealing damage heals you up to 25% Max Health. (Can not be selected together with Zealous Pilgrim)

    • Zealous Pilgrim

      • Using your Ability grants 4s of Unkillable. 

        • Shroudfield: starts on leaving Stealth; 

        • Chorus of Spiritual Fortitude: starts on unwielding the relic;

        • Chastise the Wicked / Fury of the Faithful: on ability use.

        • (Can not be selected together with Holy Revenant)

    • Fire and Fury

      • While Unkillable, weapon attacks apply Burn (up to 12 stacks). Melee attacks apply 3 stacks.

      • Risen

        • While Unkillable, each second, gain +5 Max Toughness, stacking 8 times, lasting 5 seconds.

Dev Note: We are removing some less sought after nodes, and adding in some hopefully more exciting ones.

  • Punishment - Removed

  • Impassible - Removed

  • Grievous Wounds - Removed

  • Got Your Back - New

    • Killing an enemy that is targeting an ally, with a melee attack, restores 7.5% Toughness to that ally and an additional 5% to yourself.

  • Holy Tools - New

    • +20% Damage on your next Melee Attack, within 5s after activating your Weapon Special.

  • Wait in Line - New

    • -20% damage taken from ranged attacks.

  • Purifying Hatred - New

    • +15% damage vs Burning or Electrocuted enemies.

Dev Note: We are making improvements to the few Ranged Talents available, as well as giving small bumps to often overlooked ones.

  • The Voice of Terra

    • Replenish toughness from On Kill -> While Shooting (10%/s)

  • Out of Pocket

    • Replenish Ammo from On Kill/wield -> Replenish 10% of missing magazine on melee kill

  • Unseen Blade

    • Damage 15% -> 20%.

  • Retributor’s Stance

    • Toughness per stack 0.4% -> 0.5% (max 8% -> 10%)

Dev Note: The Chorus of Spiritual Fortitude has been high above the power of its competitors for a long time; we are making changes with the intent of making it more fair, without straying from its purpose.

  • Chorus of Spiritual Fortitude (Ability)

    • Adds bonus toughness when the player is at Full Toughness -> Always adds

    • Pulses 7 -> 5

Dev Note: Fewer pulses should make it feel snappier to use, and with the change to always add the extra toughness, you should feel like you’re still getting the full value of it.

  • After the first tick, only enemies within 8m are staggered/suppressed

  • Invulnerable -> Unkillable

Dev Note: Previously it would stagger and suppress enemies throughout the whole duration, effectively stunning everything. Now it will give your team some breathing use as you activate it, but you will still need to be on your guard and consider its timing as ranged enemies can start firing again before you lower the Relic.

  • Holy Cause (subnode): 40% Toughness Damage Reduction after 5 pulses -> Each pulse grants 8% Toughness Damage Reduction, stacking 5 times.

  • Ecclesiarch’s Call (subnode): +30% Damage after 5 pulses -> Each pulse grants +6% Damage, stacking  5 times.

Psyker

We are making changes to the Talent Tree Layout, by merging the two clusters there previously were above and below the Auras. We are also changing the bottom of the tree to make it easier to pick nodes that previously were on far apart branches.

  • Stat Nodes Removed

    • 10% Ranged Damage

    • 10% Melee Damage

    • 1 Stamina

    • 5% Movement Speed

    • 5% Toughness Damage Reduction

    • -10% Peril Generation

    • 5% Critical Chance

Dev Note: A small bump in Critical Chance to lessen the blow of losing the 5% Stat Node. The Movement Speed we have included in ‘Mind in Motion’.

  • Base Critical Chance

    • Increased from 7.5% -> 10%.

  • Mind in Motion

    • Now also provides 5% Movement Speed.

Dev Note: We are replacing some less interesting nodes with new ones and adjusting a couple existing ones.

  • Tranquility Through Slaughter - Removed

  • Focused Warp - New

    • +15% Warp damage.

  • Peril Equilibrium - New

    • Non-Warp melee/ranged hits generate Peril up to 75% by 2% per hit.

  • Psykinetic Grip - New

    • +20% damage for Brain Rupture, Smite, and Assail.

  • Psykinetic's Aura

    • Specialist/Elite Kills from you or allies in coherency -> from you only

    • Duration 5s -> 3s.

  • Perilous Combustion

    • Stacks 3 -> 2

  • Surety of Arms

    • Peril threshold 75% -> 80%.

Veteran

We are updating the Veteran Layout with a goal to reduce the amount of points you need to spend to get to the nodes you actually want.

  • Stat Nodes Removed

Dev Note: You will find the Movement Speed added into the ‘Duck and Dive’ Talent. 20 Toughness has been added to the Base Toughness of the Veteran, and the Base Stamina Regeneration Delay has been reduced by 0.25.

  • 10% Ranged Damage

  • 10% Reload Speed

  • 5% Movement Speed

  • 1 Stamina

  • −0.25s Stamina Regeneration Delay

  • 15 Toughness

  • 25 Toughness

  • Base Toughness 100 -> 120

  • Base Stamina Regeneration Delay 0.75 -> 0.5

  • Duck and Dive

    • Now also grants 5% Movement Speed.

Dev Note: The Veteran should be considered ‘the’ Ranged Class.

  • Guardsman - New Iconic Passive

    • +25% Ranged Damage

Dev Note: The Survivalist Aura of the Veteran has long sustained its ammo economy. We think the effect is an excellent addition to the Veteran, but that it holds too much power in comparison to its competing auras. We are making the Survivalist effect an Iconic passive for the Veteran, and lowering the values of the Aura itself.

  • Practiced Efficiency - New Iconic Passive

    • Elite and Specialist kills restore 1% Ammo. 5s cooldown.

  • Survivalist (Aura)

    • Ammo Restore Base 0.75% -> 0.25%

    • Ammo Restore Improved 1% -> 0.5%

  • Close and Kill (Aura)

    • Movement Speed 5% -> 7.5%

  • Deadshot

    • Stamina drained per second 0.75 -> 0.33

  • Voice of Command (Ability)

    • Duty and Honour: Toughness 50 -> 75

Dev Note: We are reducing the efficiency of Golden Toughness, and to make up for some of the lost power, we’re increasing the Toughness provided by Duty and Honour.

Arbites

  • Nuncio-Aquila (Ability)

    • Tap/Fast Deploy will now slowly follow the Arbitrator.

Dev Note: A long awaited quality of life feature for the Nuncio-Aquila. May it help you dispense justice further and wider than before.

  • Lone Wolf (No Cyber-Mastiff Keystone)

    • Damage bonus 10% -> 20%

Dev Note: The Cyber-Mastiff doesn’t just provide excellent utility, but also deals a decent amount of damage. The Lone Wolf playstyle could use some more offensive power to better compare.

Hive Scum

  • Rampage (Ability)

    • Strength 50% -> 35%

Dev Note: The Melee playstyle has proven much stronger than we initially intended, so we are tuning down Rampage just a bit to give room for the other abilities to compete.

  • Sample Collector

    • 1%/2% -> 0.5s/1s

Dev Note: We want Sample Collector to incentivize using lower viscosity Stimms, which had an opposite effect when it was percentage base.

  • Street Tough

    • Now triggers on non-disabling specialist melee attacks.

Skitarius

We are overall very happy with where the Skitarius has landed after the recent update to its Blitz Abilities, but there are still a lot of nodes that could use some tuning, either up or down.

  • Advanced Combat Doctrines

Dev Note: Advanced Combat Doctrines has had a chance to prove itself now, and we think it’s lacking a bit. We’re removing the Readiness Doctrines subnode and adding it to the Base Ability.

  • Ability now includes 25% Reload Speed for 5s after use (same effect as Readiness Doctrines, baked in)

  • Readiness Doctrines - Removed

Dev Note: The Axial Slash Chordclaw subnode proved to be a little too efficient in clearing Elites when it had no Cleave fall off, so we are scaling the Damage and Impact down as you slice through multiple targets. You should still have no problem clearing the lesser enemies.

  • Chordclaw Strike - Axial Slash Subnode

    • Damage: 500 -> Scaling from 500 to 300 over 6 targets

    • Impact: 100 -> Scaling from 100 to 50 over 6 targets

Dev Note: Voltaic Emitter inherently scales based on the Capacitance Charges used, but its subnodes didn’t, which could make using them a bit awkward. We’re adding Charge scaling to Voltaic Motivator and Voltaic Overcharge.

  • Voltaic Emitter (ability)

    • Voltaic Motivator - Attack Speed now scales with Charges used: 5% + 5% per Charge spent

    • Voltaic Overcharge - Toughness on use 25% -> 25% per Charge used

  • Higher Purpose

    • Capacitance 5% ->  2.5%

  • Noospheric Command

    • Capacitance Cost 25% -> 30%

  • Voltaic Burst

    • Cooldown 15s -> 12s

  • Ammunition Deposit

    • Ammo Bonus 10% -> 15%

  • System Shock

    • Stacks 4 -> 3

  • Galvanized Coating

    • Cost on hit 5% -> 7.5%

  • Target-Neutralization

    • Duration 4s -> 5s

  • Salvation Doctrine

    • Revive Speed 20% -> 25%

    • Damage Reduction 20% -> 25%

  • Superior Tracking Litanies

    • Spread reduction 30% -> 45%

  • Force Distributors Actuators

    • Stamina threshold 75% -> 50%

Weapon Balance Changes

  • Ogryn Slab Shield & Battle Maul 

Dev Note: the Ogryn Slab Shield relied a lot on its strong Heavy Shield attacks,

while most of the Light attacks were neglected.
We are updating the properties and adding a new combo path for all Light attacks, to allow the whole moveset to be used in interesting ways.

  • Increased Light Relentless profile damage on 2nd and 3rd targets

  • Updated the Pushfollow attack profile to be aligned to other Light Strikedown attacks

  • Added Melee Block properties during Heavy 2 windups

  • Slightly lowered the chain time from Push to Pushfollow attack

  • Added chain to Special Shield plant from Pushfollow attack

  • Changed chain out of Light 4 from Light 1 / Heavy 1 to Light 3 / Heavy 1

  • Light 3 and Light 4 will now loop between themselves, gaining +10% attack speed

  • Tweaked hitboxes and ranges for some attacks

  • Relic Blade Sprint Heavy Stab 

Dev Note: The Relic Blade Heavy Stab from Sprint is one of the most powerful single target attacks of the family, but was also too easily accessible when already in close melee combat with enemies.

We are rebalancing the profile by lowering the baseline damage and the Armour Damage Modifier against Unyielding enemies by around 20%, and conversely adding a stacking Melee Strength bonus that is gained by charging the Heavy Stab while Sprinting for a small amount of time.

The current full power of the attack can still be obtained, but only after Sprinting for a little while and not from super short Sprints performed just to enter the Heavy Stab attack windup.

  • Lowered the baseline performance of the Heavy stab attack on Sprint, and added a Melee Power bonus stacking up over time while Sprinting

    • Up to 3 Stacks of +8% Melee Strength (max +24%)

  • Lowered the Unyielding ADM for the attack profile

    • Normal from 1.2 to 1.1

    • Special Activated from 1.5 to 1.33

  • Thunder Hammers 

Dev Note: Other more well rounded weapons offered enough power to make the Thunder Hammers slowly redundant, even in their single-target deleting niche.

We are adding a large amount of buffs to the weapon family, with also specific tweaks for each mark, to make them both more reliable against larger groups of enemies and more decisive against single targets.

The “Thrust” Blessing, which was often a key part of the Thunder Hammers gameplan, centralized too much power into itself. We are rebalancing the Blessing by adding part of its bonus as an inherent property of the weapon, to also promote experimenting with other Blessings and build styles.

We had an overall pass on all attack profiles, with a generous increase to their 1st target offensive properties, in particular regarding the Finesse multiplier and their armour modifiers against Maniac enemies.

The Ironhelm mark received in particular several tweaks to smooth out and polish its moveset.

  • Rebalanced the “Thrust” Blessing:

    • Lowered the Thrust blessing values from +5/10/15/20% (max +15/30/45/60%) to +5/7.5/10/12.5% (max +15/22.5/30/37.5%)

    • Added an inherent Melee Strength bonus stacking when charging any Heavy windup

      • Up to 3 stacks of +12.5% Melee Strength (max +37.5%)

  • “Shock and Awe” Blessing:

    • Increased duration from 2s to 3s

  • Heavy Relentless

    • 1st target ADM vs Maniac from 0.75 to 0.9

    • 1st target Damage from {180,350} to {215,430}

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from {0.25, 0.75} to {0.5, 1.0}

    • 2nd target Damage from {100,200} to {120,240}

    • Maniac Impact ADM on both 1st and secondary targets from 0.5 to 0.8

  • Heavy Strikedown

    • Cleave from double to medium

    • 1st target ADM vs Maniac from 0.75 to 0.9

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from {0.25, 0.95} to {0.7, 1.4}

  • Heavy Relentless / Strikedown, Special active (Crucis)

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from 0.5 to {0.5, 1.0}

  • Heavy Relentless, Special active (Ironhelm)

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from 0.5 to {0.5, 0.75}

  • Heavy Strikedown, Special active (Ironhelm)

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from 0.5 to {0.5, 1.0}

  • Light Strikedowns 1st target

    • ADM vs Maniac from 0.75 to 0.9

    • ADM vs Carapace Armour from 0.5 to 0.6

    • ADM vs Infested from 0.75 to 0.9

  • Light Strikedown

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from {0.5, 1.5} to {0.9, 1.8}

  • Light Strikedown Plus

    • Cleave from single to double

    • Increased Impact on 1st and 2nd targets

  • Light Vanguard 1st target

    • ADM vs Maniac from 0.75 to 0.9

    • ADM vs Infested from 0.75 to 0.9

    • Damage from {100,200} to {125,250}

  • Light Vanguard

    • added 3rd target scaling

  • Crucis mark

    • Increased speed for Light 1 by around 15%

    • Tweaked hitboxes for Light 1 and Heavy Strikedown after Special activation

  • Ironhelm mark

    • Added Allowed during Sprint for all attacks

    • Tweaked hitboxes for Light 1 and Heavy 3

    • Changed chain after Push > Special Activate; it will now chain into Light 1 / Heavy 3 instead of Light 1 / Heavy 1 (same Heavy as non-activated)

    • Increased speed for Special Activate actions by around 20% (now faster)

    • Added alternative Light after push with Light Strikedown plus profile

    • Added alternative Light Vanguard after Pushfollow, chaining into Light 1 / Heavy 3

    • Increased hitbox for Light 1

    • Increased range and hitbox for Pushfollow attack

  • “On Perfect Block” Blessings 

Dev Note: The “Counterattack”, “Energy Transfer” and “Lightning Reflexes” weapon Blessings required a very hard to perform Perfect Block to be triggered.

We are moving most of the bonuses to be triggered by just any Block, to raise their uptime and to make them more competitive against the rest of the Blessings pool.

  • “Counterattack”

    • Trigger from On Perfect Block to just On Block

    • Duration from 5s to 6s

    • Allow for the bonuses to be refreshed during their duration

  • “Energy Transfer”

    • Trigger from On Perfect Block to just On Block

    • Allow for the bonuses to be refreshed during their duration

  • “Lightning Reflexes”

    • Trigger for the Melee Strength bonus from On Perfect Block to just On Block

      • The Stun part of the Blessing will still be triggered On Perfect Block

  • The Blessings are available on the following weapon families:

    • Relic Blade

    • Power Falchion

    • Shock Maul

    • Arbites Shock Maul

    • Arbites Shock Maul & Shield

    • Arc Maul

  • Ogryn Pickaxe 

    • Heavy Vanguard

      • Cleave from {5,25} to {5,18}

      • Added Shield Breaker tag

    • Heavy Strikedown

      • Added Shield Breaker tag

  • Crowbar 

    • Heavy Strikedown (beak mode)

      • Added Ignore Stagger Reduction also to initial attack

      • Added Shield Breaker to both initial and second sticky attacks

  • Combat Axes 

    • Added Allowed during Sprint to all attacks and attack starts

    • Achlys Mk VIII mark

Dev Note: The Achlys mark of the Combat Axes was a bit lacking compared to its other

siblings. We have increased the offensive properties of its Heavy Strikedown and Special Uppercut attacks, particularly adding the Shield Breaker tag, which means that they will be very useful when fighting against the Vanguard enemies.

  • Slightly increased range on all attacks

  • Tweaked hitboxes, damage windows and chain times for several attacks

  • Heavy Strikedown (Spike profile)

    • Added Shield Breaker tag

    • Cleave from no cleave to single cleave

    • 1st target damage from {150,300} to {155,310}

    • 2nd target damage from {125,200} to {100,200}

  • Special Uppercut

    • Added bespoke profile with high 1st target damage and Unyielding ADM, counts as Heavy, and Shield Breaker tag

    • Chain time to Block from 1.2 to 1

    • Added chain time to itself at 1.2

  • Heavy 2

    • Time scale from 0.9 to 1 (sped up by around 10%)

    • Chain time to Special from 0.5 to 0.4

  • Heavy 3

    • Time scale from 1 to 1.1 (sped up by around 10%)

    • Release chain from windup from 0.6 to 0.45

    • Chain time to Special from 0.73 to 0.6

  • Pushfollow attack

    • Changed from Relentless side swipe to Vanguard diagonal

  • Added a new Light 2 attack

    • Similar Strikedown profile as other Light attacks

  • Added power level 550 to Heavy 3 and Light 4

  • Dual Shivs, Duelling Swords 

    • Slightly increased the minimum time for the Block action

  • Fix for swap/sprint cancel exploits

Dev Note: The starting Light attack immediately after Wield on several melee weapons and the Primary Hipfire shot of Force Staves could be repeated at a higher speed than intended (i.e. way faster than normally canceling into another attack by swapping to another weapon/wieldable slot and then back immediately to the primary slot, or by sprinting). This change will not affect normal gameplay. 

  • Added a minimum enforced time before some attack actions can be repeated.
    Affecting the following weapon families:

    • Force Staves

    • Shivs

    • Bone Saw

    • Relic Blade

    • Shock Maul

    • Arbites Shock Maul

    • Arbites Shock Maul and Shield

    • Force Sword

    • Force Greatsword

    • Duelling Sword

    • Combat Axe

    • Tactical Axe

    • Eviscerator

  • The ‘Blazing Spirit’ Blessing now has a separate stack value for the Blaze Force Greatswords Warp Slash Special attack, scaling from 1 to 3 through Blessing tiers.

Fixes
General Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where the Skitarii ‘Chordclaw Strike’ ability could be used without consuming Capacitance.

  • Fixed an issue where the game could freeze if a friend joined the Strike Team, if the account had a very large amount of friends.

  • Fixed instances where a player could drop into an ongoing vox conversation as they loaded into the Mourningstar.

  • Fixed an issue in Expeditions where the team’s Salvage amounts could be displayed incorrectly for the local player.

  • Fixed an issue that caused Corruptor pustules to incorrectly mark themselves as targets when destroyed.

  • Placing Mines now only plays the drop animation if placement is possible.

  • Fixed Arbites’ ‘Soulguilt Scan’, Veteran’s ‘Marksman’ and Ogryn’s ‘Strike True’ talents increasing Stagger strength to non-weakspot hits.

  • Fixed an issue where the description of some talents would not appear in the Tactical Overlay.

  • Fixed Zealot’s ‘Master-Crafted Shroudfield’ appearing twice in the Tactical Overlay.

  • Fixed an issue where electrocution from the Arc Maul Blessings ‘Lightning Reflexes’ and ‘Overwhelming Force’ would not trigger the ‘System Shock’ talent.

  • Fixed an issue where the Arc Maul’s innate electrocution effect would trigger the ‘System Shock’ talent only on the first hit.

  • Fixed an issue where the Hive Scum Stimm ‘Spur V’ talent would not correctly give the Slow and Stun immune keywords.

  • Fixed an issue where the Medicae Crate could not be pinged after deployment.

  • Fixed instances where players or enemies could fail to display outlines.

  • Fixed an issue where a Heavy Attack could be reset to a Light Attack after using an Ability such as the Zealot's 'Fury of the Faithful'.

  • Fixed an issue where an objective could be triggered twice in the Clandestium Gloriana mission.

  • Fixed misplaced batteries for the Medicae Stations in the No Man's Land and Vigil Station Oblivium missions.

  • Fixed an issue where players could get stuck behind machinery in the Ascension Riser 31 mission.

  • Fixed navigation issues in several missions that could cause players to get outside the intended gameplay space.

  • Fixed incorrect plus sign instead of minus sign in the description of the ‘Focused Cooling’ weapon Blessing

    • Dev Note: this is a display only change, the gameplay is not affected.

  • Fixed an issue where some weapons failed to trigger the correct visual effects when hitting Infested enemies.

  • Fixed an issue where player names could fail to appear in cutscene subtitles.

  • Fixed an issue in Comms-Plex 154/2F where walking too close to a fence would cause ledge hanging.

  • Fixed an issue where changing eye type in the character creator or Barber-Chirurgeon would reset the selected eye colour to the first option.

  • Fixed an issue where corners in the character creation and Inventory screens did not use Forge World specific colours when playing as Skitarius.

  • Fixed an issue where some crosshairs (most noticeable on the Plasma Gun) were too narrow or wide after using the ‘Chordclaw Strike’ Ability.

  • Fixed an issue where the Psyker’s 'Telekine Shield' Ability would not block projectiles at its extreme edges.

  • Added the appropriate "braced" keywords to weapon families that previously had them missing, causing talents that rely on bracing to not work:

    • Arc Rifle

    • Plasma Guns

    • Double-Barreled Shotguns

    • Stub Revolvers

    • Exterminator Shotguns

  • Fixed an issue where Hive Scum’s ‘Hyper Critical’ talent triggering would prevent ‘Blinder/Blackout’ Blitz stacks from building up.

  • Fixed a UI issue where the line drawn from the starting node to Hive Scum's top-most talent overshot the talent when filled.

  • Fix a rare server crash which could occur when interacting with something while wielding the Arbites Exterminator Shotgun.

  • Fixed a visual issue where Penances remained claimable after claiming them in the categories menus.

  • Fixed a rare crash occurring when entering the keybinds screen.

  • Fixed an issue where Hive Scum's ‘Adrenaline Smiter’ talent would fail to grant a stack if the enemy was killed by a sticky attack.

  • Fixed an issue where the progress towards replenishing a ‘Blinder/Blackout’ Blitz for Hive Scum would not be visible in the buff icons UI area in some missions.

  • Fixed an issue where the Plasma Gun’s ‘Optimised Cooling’ Blessing description incorrectly mentioned Charge Speed instead of Heat generation.

  • Fixed the Skitarii’s ‘Slice and Dice’ talent missing description in the Tactical Overlay.

  • Fixed the Valkyrie intro dialogue for the Sefoni and Morrow versions of Ascension Riser 31.

  • Fixed a rare crash that occurred when changing nameplate settings during a mission.

  • Fixed an issue where Toughness Replenishment effects could be applied to players multiple times from a single Hive Scum ‘Stimm Field’.

  • Fixed an issue where Hive Scum's ‘Adrenaline Frenzy’ talent would remove move speed penalties from melee weapon attacks.

  • Fixed an issue where the companion name was getting randomized instead of getting the actual name when performing a Personality Scourge at the Barber-Chirurgeon.

  • Scab & Dreg Vanguard: Fixed an issue where staggering these two enemies with player abilities would result in the wrong stagger being played

  • Fixed an issue where the first tick of the Peril Quell action would not be affected by Quell speed modifiers.

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Fixed implant cosmetics to better blend with different skin tones.

  • Fixed gap between headgear and hair on ‘Witchhunter's Hat’.

  • ‘Rudimentary Eyepiece With Bandana’ now correctly shows the eyepiece.

  • Fixed hair clipping on ‘Hood of Merciless Faith’.

  • Fixed harsh shadow on ‘Templar's Flak Vest’.

  • Fixed beards clipping through the face scarf on ‘Vostroyan Hat with Scarf’.

  • Changed the voice filter on the ‘Arbitrator Castigator Hood’ cosmetic.

  • Fixed hair clipping on the ‘Penitent's Hood’ cosmetic.

  • Fixed harsh shadow on the left shoulder and straps of the ‘Tanker Commander's Battlegear’ upper body cosmetic.

  • Fixed harsh shadow on the left shoulder and straps of the ‘Templar's Flak Vest’ cosmetic.

  • Reduced facial hair clipping on the ‘Obscurus Psychic Hood’ cosmetic.

  • Reduced hair clipping on the ‘Witchhunter's Hat’ cosmetic.

  • Added missing sound effects to the 'Faithbound Flak Vest' cosmetic.

Known Issues

  • New Penances related to Spillway mention finishing missions on Damnation on the Auric mission board, when it should instead mention finishing missions on Auric on the Maelstrom mission board.

  • New Penances related to Spillway mention the Sedition difficulty that no longer exists.

That’s all for today! Look forward to the full release of the update later today, at 14:00!

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar. 

– The Darktide Team

Warband!

Patch 1.13.0 is now being rolled out on all platforms! The ‘Depths of the Damned’ Free Update is releasing later today, at 14:00 CEST. In the meantime, you can check out the patch notes below to read all about the changes, as well as the content coming with the Free Update, such as the new mission, new weapons, and more!

14:00 CEST - Free Update, Depths of the Damned

New Story Mini-Campaign: Terrors of the Deep

This update comes with a brand new Story Mini-Campaign, a series of three missions with a connected narrative, similar to the ‘Battle for Tertium’ campaign or the ‘No Man’s Land’ mini-campaign. The first two missions will be in ‘Consignment Yard’ and ‘Enclavum Baross’, as the Strike Team sets out to aid noble allies of the Inquisition.

The third and final mission will be in ‘Spillway’, a brand new mission releasing with this update. The Strike Team must venture into the depths of the Torrent to aid the Ragged King and investigate the hidden horrors…

New Mission: Spillway

Descend to the depths of the Torrent in the new mission: Spillway. The Ragged King is losing Water Cartel members to something lurking in the warren of sewers beneath the ancient dam. Get down there, clear out the Traitorous Sixth and deal with whatever has made its lair down there.

Read all about it in our previous Feature Highlight, here!

New Boss: The Prophet of Decay

The new Spillway mission has a surprise at the end… get ready to face a brand new boss fight, unique to this level! Who is the source of the corruption festering in the Depths? How will you defeat him?

A terrifyingly powerful Psyker of Nurgle… Are you ready to face the Prophet of Decay?

New Weapons

Read all about the new weapon families and marks coming out with Depths of the Damned here!

Krourk Mk IIa Cruncher

“We're gonna need a bigger bonk, sah”

Overview

An industrial sledgehammer of immense weight and size, this weapon can only be wielded by equally enormous Ogryns.

While each swing is ponderous, it also carries huge stagger, above average cleave potential, and amazing reach.

The moveset of the weapon is straightforward, allowing to chain attacks in a pleasing, destructive rhythm.

Additionally, if the windup of an Heavy or Special attack is maintained for a longer period of time, the weapon will accumulate up to 4 stacks of +10% Melee Strength for the following attack.

This weapon is available to the Ogryn class.

Weapon Special

Pressing the Special input initiates a unique windup animation, raising the Cruncher above the Ogryn’s head and giving access to devastating Strikedown attacks.

If the Special input is released immediately, the weapon will perform a Light 1 or Light 4 attack (depending on the combo chain); if the input is held, the weapon will release an Heavy Special Strikedown attack.

Attacks

  • Light 1: Moderately fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Impact and Damage.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

  • Light 2: Moderately fast, diagonal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.

  • Light 3: Moderately fast, diagonal uppercut Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.

    • Chains into Light 4 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

    • Also accessed while in a Slide stance.

  • Light 4: Moderately fast, vertical Strikedown attack with good Impact and Damage.

    • Chains into Light 1 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.

  • Heavy 1: Slow, horizontal Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

  • Heavy 2: Slow, horizontal Relentless attack with great Cleave and Impact over secondary targets.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.

  • Push-attack: Fast, horizontal Relentless attack with good Impact and Cleave.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

  • Special 1: Very slow, vertical Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.

    • Chains into Light 2 and Heavy 2, or Light 4 and Special 2.

  • Special 2: Very slow, vertical Strikedown attack with great Damage and Impact.

    • Also accessed after a Push.

    • Chains into Light 3 and Heavy 1, or Light 1 and Special 1.

Suggested Horde combos

  • H1 > H2 > H1 > …

  • H1 > L2 > L3 > H2 > …

  • Push-attack > L2/H2 > …

  • (Slide) > L3 > H2 > …

Suggested Single Target combos

  • Sp1 > Sp2 > Sp1 > …

  • L1 > (Special) L4 > L1 > …

  • (Any) > Sp1/Sp2 > …

  • (Any) > (Special) L1/L4 > …

Blessings

  1. Hammerblow

    1. +19-25% Impact for 1.5s on Hit. Stacks 5 times.

  2. Execution

    1. +5-20% Damage Bonus vs Staggered enemies.

  3. All or Nothing: Up to +15-30% Strength, as Stamina depletes. (Note that this version of the Blessing scales for every 12.5% depleted Stamina, instead of 20%.)

  4. Limbsplitter: +17.5-25% Strength on your First Attack every 2 seconds.

  5. Slow and Steady: Recover 15-24% toughness when hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, based on charge time.

  6. Shock & Awe: - 30-60% Enemy Hit Mass for 3s on Kill.

As part of the Depths of the Damned Free Update, we have a balance update. Our focus has been on improving the base classes talent trees, overall class balance, weapon balance, and addressing Golden Toughness and its impact on both player builds and our overall design space for the future. Since we are making changes that will affect all players, regardless of class and loadout, it’s important for us to go through our thought process.

The original four Classes are receiving several changes to their talent trees, with a particular focus on reducing the number of stat nodes required to complete your build, and improving the paths through the trees with the intent of providing more interesting choices and improving buildcraft. We are also looking to reinforce what makes the Veteran and Zealot stand out from the other Classes, by taking a closer look at their themes and mechanics. The Skitarius has now had some time to settle, so we are also going over its talents and abilities and making some targeted adjustments. NOTE: Since the changes affect the layout of the trees, your loadouts may need slight rearrangements to amend broken connections or reapplying of points to make up for removed talents. Rest assured that these are only partial resets.

Several Melee Weapons are also receiving changes, with the Thunder Hammer in particular getting some extra attention. 

Finally, we are taking a closer look at Golden Toughness. In May, we outlined our intention to improve combat balance by addressing some of the outliers in player power, and took the first steps by adjusting Carapace Armoured enemies and the players tools to deal with them. You can read that balance blog here. 

Our commitment is still to preserve the intensity of the combat, while making it more stable, more readable, and more supportive of different builds and loadouts. Adjusting Golden Toughness is another step towards that long-term goal.

Golden Toughness

Golden Toughness is one of the more disruptive mechanics in Darktide. By changing the way damage and toughness interact, it can obscure some of the core rules of combat.

Many players are naturally guided towards abilities that provide Golden Toughness, and these abilities can be highly effective even before a player has developed a strong understanding of the mechanics they are intended to learn, e.g. positioning, and how to engage each type of enemy. This can allow difficult situations to be bypassed or diffused without engaging with the underlying threats, making it harder for players to build that understanding through the intended learning curve.

When Golden Toughness was first introduced to Abilities, Darktide was in a very different state. Since then, the overall difficulty and complexity of the game has increased, and the value of Golden Toughness has increased alongside it. As its value has grown, it has also become increasingly difficult to balance abilities against one another without making Golden Toughness a prerequisite for competing with its level of defensive power.

We want Toughness to have consistent and understandable rules regardless of how it is obtained. To that end, we are removing the Spillover Immunity effect from Golden Toughness. It will now follow the same damage calculation rules as regular Toughness.

This means that Golden Toughness will continue to provide additional protection, but it will no longer allow a single point of Toughness to fully absorb the damage of an otherwise lethal attack. The result should be a more consistent combat system, and greater room for us to balance defensive abilities against one another.

Dev Note: The Relic Blade Heavy Stab from Sprint is one of the most powerful single target attacks of the family, but was also too easily accessible when already in close melee combat with enemies.

We are rebalancing the profile by lowering the baseline damage and the Armour Damage Modifier against Unyielding enemies by around 20%, and conversely adding a stacking Melee Strength bonus that is gained by charging the Heavy Stab while Sprinting for a small amount of time.

The current full power of the attack can still be obtained, but only after Sprinting for a little while and not from super short Sprints performed just to enter the Heavy Stab attack windup.

  • Lowered the baseline performance of the Heavy stab attack on Sprint, and added a Melee Power bonus stacking up over time while Sprinting

    • Up to 3 Stacks of +8% Melee Strength (max +24%)

  • Lowered the Unyielding ADM for the attack profile

    • Normal from 1.2 to 1.1

    • Special Activated from 1.5 to 1.33

  • Thunder Hammers 

Dev Note: Other more well rounded weapons offered enough power to make the Thunder Hammers slowly redundant, even in their single-target deleting niche.

We are adding a large amount of buffs to the weapon family, with also specific tweaks for each mark, to make them both more reliable against larger groups of enemies and more decisive against single targets.

The “Thrust” Blessing, which was often a key part of the Thunder Hammers gameplan, centralized too much power into itself. We are rebalancing the Blessing by adding part of its bonus as an inherent property of the weapon, to also promote experimenting with other Blessings and build styles.

We had an overall pass on all attack profiles, with a generous increase to their 1st target offensive properties, in particular regarding the Finesse multiplier and their armour modifiers against Maniac enemies.

The Ironhelm mark received in particular several tweaks to smooth out and polish its moveset.

  • Rebalanced the “Thrust” Blessing:

    • Lowered the Thrust blessing values from +5/10/15/20% (max +15/30/45/60%) to +5/7.5/10/12.5% (max +15/22.5/30/37.5%)

    • Added an inherent Melee Strength bonus stacking when charging any Heavy windup

      • Up to 3 stacks of +12.5% Melee Strength (max +37.5%)

  • “Shock and Awe” Blessing:

    • Increased duration from 2s to 3s

  • Heavy Relentless

    • 1st target ADM vs Maniac from 0.75 to 0.9

    • 1st target Damage from {180,350} to {215,430}

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from {0.25, 0.75} to {0.5, 1.0}

    • 2nd target Damage from {100,200} to {120,240}

    • Maniac Impact ADM on both 1st and secondary targets from 0.5 to 0.8

  • Heavy Strikedown

    • Cleave from double to medium

    • 1st target ADM vs Maniac from 0.75 to 0.9

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from {0.25, 0.95} to {0.7, 1.4}

  • Heavy Relentless / Strikedown, Special active (Crucis)

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from 0.5 to {0.5, 1.0}

  • Heavy Relentless, Special active (Ironhelm)

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from 0.5 to {0.5, 0.75}

  • Heavy Strikedown, Special active (Ironhelm)

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from 0.5 to {0.5, 1.0}

  • Light Strikedowns 1st target

    • ADM vs Maniac from 0.75 to 0.9

    • ADM vs Carapace Armour from 0.5 to 0.6

    • ADM vs Infested from 0.75 to 0.9

  • Light Strikedown

    • 1st target Finesse multiplier from {0.5, 1.5} to {0.9, 1.8}

  • Light Strikedown Plus

    • Cleave from single to double

    • Increased Impact on 1st and 2nd targets

  • Light Vanguard 1st target

    • ADM vs Maniac from 0.75 to 0.9

    • ADM vs Infested from 0.75 to 0.9

    • Damage from {100,200} to {125,250}

  • Light Vanguard

    • added 3rd target scaling

  • Crucis mark

    • Increased speed for Light 1 by around 15%

    • Tweaked hitboxes for Light 1 and Heavy Strikedown after Special activation

  • Ironhelm mark

    • Added Allowed during Sprint for all attacks

    • Tweaked hitboxes for Light 1 and Heavy 3

    • Changed chain after Push > Special Activate; it will now chain into Light 1 / Heavy 3 instead of Light 1 / Heavy 1 (same Heavy as non-activated)

    • Increased speed for Special Activate actions by around 20% (now faster)

    • Added alternative Light after push with Light Strikedown plus profile

    • Added alternative Light Vanguard after Pushfollow, chaining into Light 1 / Heavy 3

    • Increased hitbox for Light 1

    • Increased range and hitbox for Pushfollow attack

  • “On Perfect Block” Blessings 

Dev Note: The “Counterattack”, “Energy Transfer” and “Lightning Reflexes” weapon Blessings required a very hard to perform Perfect Block to be triggered.

We are moving most of the bonuses to be triggered by just any Block, to raise their uptime and to make them more competitive against the rest of the Blessings pool.

  • “Counterattack”

    • Trigger from On Perfect Block to just On Block

    • Duration from 5s to 6s

    • Allow for the bonuses to be refreshed during their duration

  • “Energy Transfer”

    • Trigger from On Perfect Block to just On Block

    • Allow for the bonuses to be refreshed during their duration

  • “Lightning Reflexes”

    • Trigger for the Melee Strength bonus from On Perfect Block to just On Block

      • The Stun part of the Blessing will still be triggered On Perfect Block

  • The Blessings are available on the following weapon families:

    • Relic Blade

    • Power Falchion

    • Shock Maul

    • Arbites Shock Maul

    • Arbites Shock Maul & Shield

    • Arc Maul

  • Ogryn Pickaxe 

    • Heavy Vanguard

      • Cleave from {5,25} to {5,18}

      • Added Shield Breaker tag

    • Heavy Strikedown

      • Added Shield Breaker tag

  • Crowbar 

    • Heavy Strikedown (beak mode)

      • Added Ignore Stagger Reduction also to initial attack

      • Added Shield Breaker to both initial and second sticky attacks

  • Combat Axes 

    • Added Allowed during Sprint to all attacks and attack starts

    • Achlys Mk VIII mark

Dev Note: The Achlys mark of the Combat Axes was a bit lacking compared to its other

siblings. We have increased the offensive properties of its Heavy Strikedown and Special Uppercut attacks, particularly adding the Shield Breaker tag, which means that they will be very useful when fighting against the Vanguard enemies.

  • Slightly increased range on all attacks

  • Tweaked hitboxes, damage windows and chain times for several attacks

  • Heavy Strikedown (Spike profile)

    • Added Shield Breaker tag

    • Cleave from no cleave to single cleave

    • 1st target damage from {150,300} to {155,310}

    • 2nd target damage from {125,200} to {100,200}

  • Special Uppercut

    • Added bespoke profile with high 1st target damage and Unyielding ADM, counts as Heavy, and Shield Breaker tag

    • Chain time to Block from 1.2 to 1

    • Added chain time to itself at 1.2

  • Heavy 2

    • Time scale from 0.9 to 1 (sped up by around 10%)

    • Chain time to Special from 0.5 to 0.4

  • Heavy 3

    • Time scale from 1 to 1.1 (sped up by around 10%)

    • Release chain from windup from 0.6 to 0.45

    • Chain time to Special from 0.73 to 0.6

  • Pushfollow attack

    • Changed from Relentless side swipe to Vanguard diagonal

  • Added a new Light 2 attack

    • Similar Strikedown profile as other Light attacks

  • Added power level 550 to Heavy 3 and Light 4

  • Dual Shivs, Duelling Swords 

    • Slightly increased the minimum time for the Block action

  • Fix for swap/sprint cancel exploits

Dev Note: The starting Light attack immediately after Wield on several melee weapons and the Primary Hipfire shot of Force Staves could be repeated at a higher speed than intended (i.e. way faster than normally canceling into another attack by swapping to another weapon/wieldable slot and then back immediately to the primary slot, or by sprinting). This change will not affect normal gameplay. 

  • Added a minimum enforced time before some attack actions can be repeated.
    Affecting the following weapon families:

    • Force Staves

    • Shivs

    • Bone Saw

    • Relic Blade

    • Shock Maul

    • Arbites Shock Maul

    • Arbites Shock Maul and Shield

    • Force Sword

    • Force Greatsword

    • Duelling Sword

    • Combat Axe

    • Tactical Axe

    • Eviscerator

  • The ‘Blazing Spirit’ Blessing now has a separate stack value for the Blaze Force Greatswords Warp Slash Special attack, scaling from 1 to 3 through Blessing tiers.

Fixes
General Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where the Skitarii ‘Chordclaw Strike’ ability could be used without consuming Capacitance.

  • Fixed an issue where the game could freeze if a friend joined the Strike Team, if the account had a very large amount of friends.

  • Fixed instances where a player could drop into an ongoing vox conversation as they loaded into the Mourningstar.

  • Fixed an issue in Expeditions where the team’s Salvage amounts could be displayed incorrectly for the local player.

  • Fixed an issue that caused Corruptor pustules to incorrectly mark themselves as targets when destroyed.

  • Placing Mines now only plays the drop animation if placement is possible.

  • Fixed Arbites’ ‘Soulguilt Scan’, Veteran’s ‘Marksman’ and Ogryn’s ‘Strike True’ talents increasing Stagger strength to non-weakspot hits.

  • Fixed an issue where the description of some talents would not appear in the Tactical Overlay.

  • Fixed Zealot’s ‘Master-Crafted Shroudfield’ appearing twice in the Tactical Overlay.

  • Fixed an issue where electrocution from the Arc Maul Blessings ‘Lightning Reflexes’ and ‘Overwhelming Force’ would not trigger the ‘System Shock’ talent.

  • Fixed an issue where the Arc Maul’s innate electrocution effect would trigger the ‘System Shock’ talent only on the first hit.

  • Fixed an issue where the Hive Scum Stimm ‘Spur V’ talent would not correctly give the Slow and Stun immune keywords.

  • Fixed an issue where the Medicae Crate could not be pinged after deployment.

  • Fixed instances where players or enemies could fail to display outlines.

  • Fixed an issue where a Heavy Attack could be reset to a Light Attack after using an Ability such as the Zealot's 'Fury of the Faithful'.

  • Fixed an issue where an objective could be triggered twice in the Clandestium Gloriana mission.

  • Fixed misplaced batteries for the Medicae Stations in the No Man's Land and Vigil Station Oblivium missions.

  • Fixed an issue where players could get stuck behind machinery in the Ascension Riser 31 mission.

  • Fixed navigation issues in several missions that could cause players to get outside the intended gameplay space.

  • Fixed incorrect plus sign instead of minus sign in the description of the ‘Focused Cooling’ weapon Blessing

    • Dev Note: this is a display only change, the gameplay is not affected.

  • Fixed an issue where some weapons failed to trigger the correct visual effects when hitting Infested enemies.

  • Fixed an issue where player names could fail to appear in cutscene subtitles.

  • Fixed an issue in Comms-Plex 154/2F where walking too close to a fence would cause ledge hanging.

  • Fixed an issue where changing eye type in the character creator or Barber-Chirurgeon would reset the selected eye colour to the first option.

  • Fixed an issue where corners in the character creation and Inventory screens did not use Forge World specific colours when playing as Skitarius.

  • Fixed an issue where some crosshairs (most noticeable on the Plasma Gun) were too narrow or wide after using the ‘Chordclaw Strike’ Ability.

  • Fixed an issue where the Psyker’s 'Telekine Shield' Ability would not block projectiles at its extreme edges.

  • Added the appropriate "braced" keywords to weapon families that previously had them missing, causing talents that rely on bracing to not work:

    • Arc Rifle

    • Plasma Guns

    • Double-Barreled Shotguns

    • Stub Revolvers

    • Exterminator Shotguns

  • Fixed an issue where Hive Scum’s ‘Hyper Critical’ talent triggering would prevent ‘Blinder/Blackout’ Blitz stacks from building up.

  • Fixed a UI issue where the line drawn from the starting node to Hive Scum's top-most talent overshot the talent when filled.

  • Fix a rare server crash which could occur when interacting with something while wielding the Arbites Exterminator Shotgun.

  • Fixed a visual issue where Penances remained claimable after claiming them in the categories menus.

  • Fixed a rare crash occurring when entering the keybinds screen.

  • Fixed an issue where Hive Scum's ‘Adrenaline Smiter’ talent would fail to grant a stack if the enemy was killed by a sticky attack.

  • Fixed an issue where the progress towards replenishing a ‘Blinder/Blackout’ Blitz for Hive Scum would not be visible in the buff icons UI area in some missions.

  • Fixed an issue where the Plasma Gun’s ‘Optimised Cooling’ Blessing description incorrectly mentioned Charge Speed instead of Heat generation.

  • Fixed the Skitarii’s ‘Slice and Dice’ talent missing description in the Tactical Overlay.

  • Fixed the Valkyrie intro dialogue for the Sefoni and Morrow versions of Ascension Riser 31.

  • Fixed a rare crash that occurred when changing nameplate settings during a mission.

  • Fixed an issue where Toughness Replenishment effects could be applied to players multiple times from a single Hive Scum ‘Stimm Field’.

  • Fixed an issue where Hive Scum's ‘Adrenaline Frenzy’ talent would remove move speed penalties from melee weapon attacks.

  • Fixed an issue where the companion name was getting randomized instead of getting the actual name when performing a Personality Scourge at the Barber-Chirurgeon.

  • Scab & Dreg Vanguard: Fixed an issue where staggering these two enemies with player abilities would result in the wrong stagger being played

  • Fixed an issue where the first tick of the Peril Quell action would not be affected by Quell speed modifiers.

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Fixed implant cosmetics to better blend with different skin tones.

  • Fixed gap between headgear and hair on ‘Witchhunter's Hat’.

  • ‘Rudimentary Eyepiece With Bandana’ now correctly shows the eyepiece.

  • Fixed hair clipping on ‘Hood of Merciless Faith’.

  • Fixed harsh shadow on ‘Templar's Flak Vest’.

  • Fixed beards clipping through the face scarf on ‘Vostroyan Hat with Scarf’.

  • Changed the voice filter on the ‘Arbitrator Castigator Hood’ cosmetic.

  • Fixed hair clipping on the ‘Penitent's Hood’ cosmetic.

  • Fixed harsh shadow on the left shoulder and straps of the ‘Tanker Commander's Battlegear’ upper body cosmetic.

  • Fixed harsh shadow on the left shoulder and straps of the ‘Templar's Flak Vest’ cosmetic.

  • Reduced facial hair clipping on the ‘Obscurus Psychic Hood’ cosmetic.

  • Reduced hair clipping on the ‘Witchhunter's Hat’ cosmetic.

  • Added missing sound effects to the 'Faithbound Flak Vest' cosmetic.

Known Issues

  • New Penances related to Spillway mention finishing missions on Damnation on the Auric mission board, when it should instead mention finishing missions on Auric on the Maelstrom mission board.

  • New Penances related to Spillway mention the Sedition difficulty that no longer exists.

That’s all for today! Look forward to the full release of the update later today, at 14:00!

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar. 

– The Darktide Team

item.title: Performance update now live!
item.description:
Our latest performance update is now available to all players on Steam, following testing on the public beta branch.

Independent hardware testing recorded an average frame-rate improvement of around 34%, with improvements seen on 21 of the 22 systems tested. Results will vary depending on your hardware, graphics settings and what’s happening in-game.

We know performance has been a frustration for many of you. If it’s kept you from enjoying Mechanicus II, we hope this update gives you a reason to return.

Thank you to everyone who tried the beta and shared feedback. Please let us know how the update runs for you, and report any issues through the bug report form, including your system specifications and graphics settings.

Thank you for your patience and support.
